description.en: Replaces leading tabs with 2 spaces each.
description.ja: 行頭のタブを空白 2 個に置き換える

description.en: Replaces leading tabs with 4 spaces each.
description.ja: 行頭のタブを空白 4 個に置き換える

description.en: Replaces every 2 leading spaces with one tab.
description.ja: 行頭の空白 2 個ごとにタブ 1 個へ置き換える

description.en: Replaces every 4 leading spaces with one tab.
description.ja: 行頭の空白 4 個ごとにタブ 1 個へ置き換える

description.en: Re-indents 2-space indentation to 4-space indentation.
description.ja: 2 空白単位のインデントを 4 空白単位に変換する

description.en: Re-indents 4-space indentation to 2-space indentation.
description.ja: 4 空白単位のインデントを 2 空白単位に変換する

description.en: Removes only the leading indentation common to all lines (dedent).
description.ja: すべての行に共通する先頭インデントだけを取り除く

description.en: Trims only the leading whitespace of each line (**Text - Trim All Lines** trims both ends and **Text: Trim Trailing Whitespace** trims the trailing side only).
description.ja: 各行の先頭の空白だけを取り除く（**Text - Trim All Lines** は両端、**Text: Trim Trailing Whitespace** は末尾を取り除く）

description.en: Collapses consecutive blank lines into a single blank line.
description.ja: 連続する空行を 1 行にまとめる

description.en: Removes all spaces, tabs and line breaks.
description.ja: 空白・タブ・改行をすべて取り除く

description.en: Replaces line breaks within paragraphs with spaces, keeping blank lines as paragraph separators.
description.ja: 段落内の改行を空白に置き換え、空行による段落区切りは残す

description.en: Hard-wraps lines at word boundaries every 80 columns.
description.ja: 単語境界で 80 桁ごとに改行を入れる

example.en: `（a single 90-character line）` → `（2 lines wrapped at 80 columns）`
example.ja: `（90 文字の 1 行）` → `（80 桁で折り返した 2 行）`

description.en: Hard-wraps lines at word boundaries at the column width you enter.
description.ja: 単語境界で入力した桁数ごとに改行を入れる

description.en: Replaces special spaces such as NBSP (U+00A0) and thin spaces with normal spaces.
description.ja: NBSP（U+00A0）や細いスペースなど特殊な空白を通常の空白に置き換える

description.en: Makes whitespace visible by replacing spaces with "·" (U+00B7) and tabs with "→" (U+2192). In this example, the `·` and `→` on the output side are not notation symbols but the characters actually inserted.
description.ja: 空白を「·」（U+00B7）、タブを「→」（U+2192）に置き換えて見えるようにする。この例の出力側の `·` と `→` は表記ルールの記号ではなく、実際に挿入される文字である

description.en: Turns "·" (U+00B7) back into spaces and "→" (U+2192) back into tabs (the reverse of **Whitespace: Visualize Spaces and Tabs**). In this example, the `·` and `→` on the input side are the actual characters (U+00B7, U+2192), not notation symbols, while the `·` and `⇥` on the output side represent a space and a tab as usual. Any `·` `→` that existed before visualizing are also turned into spaces and tabs, so a round trip with **Whitespace: Visualize Spaces and Tabs** is not reversible.
description.ja: 「·」（U+00B7）を空白、「→」（U+2192）をタブに戻す（**Whitespace: Visualize Spaces and Tabs** の逆変換）。この例の入力側の `·` と `→` は表記ルールの記号ではなく実際の文字（U+00B7・U+2192）であり、出力側の `·` と `⇥` は表記ルールどおり空白とタブを表す。可視化する前から含まれていた `·` `→` も空白・タブに変わるため、**Whitespace: Visualize Spaces and Tabs** との往復は可逆ではない

description.en: Center-aligns each line relative to the longest line.
description.ja: 最も長い行に合わせて各行を中央寄せする

description.en: Right-aligns each line relative to the longest line.
description.ja: 最も長い行に合わせて各行を右寄せする

description.en: Pads lines with trailing spaces so that all lines are as long as the longest line.
description.ja: 末尾に空白を足して全行を最長行と同じ長さにする

description.en: Inserts spaces so that the first "=" on each line lines up. Operators containing "=" (`+=` `!=` `<=` `==` `=>`, etc.) are not split and are aligned at the start of the operator. The right side of the operator is left unchanged (`a=1⏎bb = 2` becomes `a··=1⏎bb = 2`, with no space added after "=").
description.ja: 各行の最初の「=」の位置が揃うように空白を入れる。「=」を含む演算子（`+=` `!=` `<=` `==` `=>` など）は分割せず、その演算子の先頭の位置で揃える。演算子の右側は変えない（`a=1⏎bb = 2` は `a··=1⏎bb = 2` になり、「=」の後ろに空白は入らない）

description.en: Aligns the start of the value after the first standalone ":" on each line (a ":" inside `::` is not treated as a separator). No spaces are added to lines with an empty value (`key:`).
description.ja: 各行の最初の単独の「:」の後ろの値の開始位置を揃える（`::` の中の「:」は区切りにしない）。値が空の行（`key:`）には空白を足さない

description.en: Aligns the start position of each comma-separated column.
description.ja: カンマ区切りの各列の開始位置を揃える

description.en: Inserts spaces so that the delimiter you enter lines up.
description.ja: 入力した区切り文字の位置が揃うように空白を入れる

description.en: Inserts a blank line between lines.
description.ja: 各行の間に空行を入れる

description.en: Removes only the blank lines at the end of the selection.
description.ja: 選択範囲の末尾にある空行だけを取り除く

description.en: Removes only the blank lines at the start of the selection.
description.ja: 選択範囲の先頭にある空行だけを取り除く

description.en: Collapses consecutive spaces within a line into one while keeping the indentation.
description.ja: インデントは残したまま、行中の連続空白を 1 個にまとめる

description.en: Adds one space before and after operators such as = + - \* / (string literals are not affected).
description.ja: = + - \* / などの演算子の前後に空白を 1 個入れる（文字列リテラル内は対象外）

description.en: Removes whitespace immediately before ", . ! ? ; :".
description.ja: 「, . ! ? ; :」の直前の空白を取り除く

description.en: Inserts a space after each comma that is not already followed by one.
description.ja: カンマの直後に空白がなければ 1 個入れる

description.en: Adds the number of spaces you enter to the start of each line.
description.ja: 入力した数の空白を各行の先頭に足す

description.en: Removes up to the number of spaces you enter from the start of each line.
description.ja: 各行の先頭から入力した数までの空白を取り除く

description.en: Expands all tabs, including those in the middle of lines, to spaces taking tab stops (4) into account.
description.ja: 行中のタブも含め、タブストップ（4）を考慮して空白に展開する

description.en: Converts runs of spaces that end on a tab stop (4) boundary back into tabs.
description.ja: タブストップ（4）境界に揃う連続空白をタブに戻す

description.en: Turns whitespace-only lines into empty lines.
description.ja: 空白だけの行を中身のない空行にする
